capabilities: Render csv and tsv code blocks as interactive tables
Sort and filter table columns via a toolbar
Edit table cells and write changes back to the source code block
Validate malformed CSV with row, field, and line details
Detect http, https, and mailto values and render them as links
extras: Fully local: no network requests, telemetry, accounts, or payments. Includes developer release instructions that are not user-facing.
intentEvidence: inspired by the original CSV Codeblock plugin
motivation: The author found Markdown tables tedious when data is large, frequently edited, copied from spreadsheets, or full of long text, and wanted to keep CSV/TSV as the source format while rendering a usable table.
problem: Markdown tables are tedious for large, frequently edited, or spreadsheet-copied data, while raw CSV blocks are hard to read in preview.

relations.evidence: CSV Modern Codeblock was inspired by the original CSV Codeblock plugin

summary: Renders CSV and TSV fenced code blocks as interactive tables with sticky headers, sorting, per-column filters, and cell editing.
